title: 第二十五章 炼丹师还是厨师第二十六章 大丹到手
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

万宝斋四楼。
一袭绛紫长裙，曲线婀娜，身姿丰腴的柳扶烟，坐在书房，翻看分行近日的账目。
看了一阵，柳扶烟就合上了账册，莹白玉指，轻揉眉心。
那双含嗔带媚的凤眸，此时隐隐透出疲惫和焦躁。
“唉……”
柳扶烟最近比较烦。
近来帝都分行的营收，下降了近三成之多。
一切原因，都是那名离开的三品炼丹师。
他的离去，导致分行的丹药品质，明显下滑。
虽然分行向总部，申请来一批良品丹药，却是远水难解近渴。
再加上，挖走那名炼丹师的，帝都三大商行之一‘奇轩阁’。
近来大肆宣扬，万宝斋首席炼丹师加盟奇轩阁。
并以那名炼丹师的关系网，挖走了许多万宝斋大客户。
直接导致万宝斋收入骤降。
其实这种事情，对于万宝斋这样有后台的大商行而言，也不算太大的危机。
大不了先高价采购，一些品质优良的丹药，顶上去。
再慢慢寻找，甚至培养一位，有能力的炼丹师，也就能缓过来了。
可问题的关键是，商行能等，柳扶烟却等不了。

“再过三个月，就是总部对帝都分行的考核期限，事关我能否升任帝都分行‘正掌房’。
以目前的情况来看，考核必然会受影响。
一旦考核失败，别说是分行正掌房，说不定我会被调离帝都。”
帝都分行掌房之位，可是有很多人盯着的，那些人巴不得自己考核失败。
如今商行总部，迟迟没有派来炼丹师，多半也是有人从中作梗。
“怎么偏在这种节骨眼上出问题。”
柳扶烟心情郁闷无比。
她也曾极力挽留过，那位首席炼丹师，不惜大幅提升其待遇。
奈何那人太过无耻，居然对她有那种龌龊心思。
“哼，我柳扶烟岂能被你们，如此轻易拿捏！”
就在此时，房门被敲响。
“副掌房，今日又有一位炼丹师前来应聘。”
“哦……？”
柳扶烟没有太多表情。
近来万宝斋正高薪招聘炼丹师，已经来过很多人面试。
可炼丹师实在稀有，好的炼丹师更是万中无一，大多都被一些大势力招揽。
前来面试者，能力大多差强人意。
有人十炉丹药，只能炼成一炉，品质还是下等。

The fourth floor of Wanbaozhai.
Wearing a long purple dress, Liu Fuyan, with graceful curves and plump figure, was sitting in the study, looking through the recent accounts of the branch.
After reading for a while, Liu Fuyan closed the account book and gently rubbed his eyebrows with his white jade fingers.
The pair of phoenix eyes that were filled with anger and charm were faintly showing exhaustion and anxiety.
"Alas..."
Liu Fuyan has been troubled recently.
Recently, the revenue of the Imperial City Branch has dropped by nearly 30%.
All the reasons were due to the third-grade alchemist who left.
His departure caused a significant decline in the quality of the branch's elixirs.
Although the branch applied to the headquarters for a batch of high-quality elixirs, it was difficult to quench the thirst of the people far away.
In addition, the one who poached the alchemist was ‘Qixuan Pavilion’, one of the three major trading houses in the imperial capital.
It has been widely publicized recently that the chief alchemist of Wanbaozhai has joined Qixuan Pavilion.
And using the alchemist's network, he poached many of Wanbaozhai's major customers.
This directly led to a sharp drop in Wanbaozhai's income.
In fact, this kind of thing is not a big crisis for a large trading house with a backend like Wanbaozhai.
The worst thing to do is to purchase some high-quality elixirs at a high price first.
If you slowly search for, or even train, a capable alchemist, you will be able to recover.
But the crux of the matter is that the commercial bank can wait, but Liu Fuyan cannot.
"In three months' time, the headquarters will conduct an assessment of the Imperial Capital Branch, which will affect whether I can be promoted to the 'chief manager' of the Imperial Capital Branch.
Judging from the current situation, the assessment will inevitably be affected.
Once I fail the assessment, let alone being the head of the branch, I might be transferred out of the imperial capital. "
The position of head of the Imperial Capital Branch is watched by many people, who are eager to fail the assessment.
Nowadays, the headquarters of the trading company has not sent an alchemist for a long time, and most likely someone is causing trouble.
"Why did something go wrong at this juncture?"
Liu Fuyan was extremely depressed.
She also tried her best to retain the chief alchemist, and did not hesitate to significantly increase his salary.
However, that person was too shameless to have such dirty thoughts towards her.
"Hmph, how can I, Liu Fuyan, be manipulated so easily by you guys!"
At this moment, there was a knock on the door.
"Deputy Headmaster, another alchemist has come to apply for the job today."
"Oh...?"
Liu Fuyan didn't have much expression.
Recently, Wanbaozhai is recruiting alchemists with high salaries, and many people have come for interviews.
But alchemists are really rare, and good alchemists are rare. Most of them are recruited by some big forces.
Most of the people who come for interviews have unsatisfactory abilities.
Some people can only make one pot of elixir out of ten pots, but the quality is still inferior.
